name: Tryndamere
notes: Undying Rage is cast at t = 0 purely for its instant Fury burst; its minimum-health threshold and 5 s duration are defensive and not read by the damage fight.

Bloodlust (Q) is never cast: it consumes 100% of current Fury for a heal, which would zero out Fury-derived crit chance for the rest of the fight in exchange for healing the damage fight never rewards.

Mocking Shout (W) is never cast (see "unused"): it only reduces the AD of, and slows, nearby enemy champions, and the stationary dummy never attacks or moves, so it has no effect on the fight; its 0.3 s cast time is therefore irrelevant and no time is spent on it.

Bloodlust's passive bonus AD scales with Tryndamere's own missing health; since the dummy never damages Tryndamere, his missing health stays at 0 for the whole fight, so this passive contributes 0 AD throughout and is omitted from the driver.
Spinning Slash (E) is cast on cooldown; its damage and its 5 Fury (champion hit) land instantly since it has no cast time.

Fury is generated by basic attacks (+5, or +10 instead of +5 on a critical strike, per the wiki's plain reading of Battle Fury). Since crit chance is itself continuous (derived from current Fury), each attack's Fury gain is modeled as its expected value, 5 + 5 * (that attack's combined crit chance), and that same combined crit chance is used in expectation to shave Spinning Slash's cooldown by its on-crit refund (treated as champion-target refund, since the dummy is a champion).

Fury converts to crit chance at 0.5% per point of Fury, capped at 100 Fury (50% crit chance). This stacks additively with any itemized crit chance up to 100% total; only the incremental (non-itemized) portion of that chance is added as extra expected physical damage on each attack, since the engine's own basic-attack damage already accounts for itemized crit chance.

Fury decay (5 per second after 8 seconds without dealing or taking damage) is not modeled: at level 16 Tryndamere is always either attacking or casting Spinning Slash well within an 8 second gap, so decay never triggers during this fight.

unused.W: Mocking Shout only reduces the target's bonus AD and slows it while facing away; the stationary dummy never attacks or moves, so casting it against the dummy changes nothing in the damage fight and it is never cast.
